provenance_note: Expected values recorded from an independently authored corpus written from SPEC-obsolescenceltb.md without the page code; this run executes the shipping build against them and re-derives nothing.
reference: Independent blind reference written from SPEC-obsolescenceltb.md rev 2026-10-02.1 only: Poisson probabilities with mpmath at 50 digits (route 1: regularized incomplete gamma, doubling+bisection, bisection for T_S) cross-checked by a second route (explicit pmf recurrence sums, direct double summation and complement formula, brute linear scan over Q, secant root of F(S; lambda t) = P*), empirical cases in exact rational arithmetic.
reference_citations: Loader, C. (2000). Fast and accurate computation of binomial probabilities (saddle-point dpois form)
Johnson, N. L., Kemp, A. W., Kotz, S. (2005). Univariate Discrete Distributions, 3rd ed., ch. 4 (Poisson; F(k; mu) = Q(k+1, mu))
mpmath 1.x arbitrary-precision library: gammainc (regularized), loggamma, findroot
tolerance: available, q, criterion_met, issues, warnings, actions, sensitivity_q, decision_approved, approval_stale exact (code lists as sorted sets); coverage and lead_coverage 1e-9 absolute; rate 1e-9 relative; stock_coverage_time, inventory_trigger, latest_order_by, replacement_start_by 1e-6 a absolute; risk 1e-9 absolute; only keys present in expected are compared

manifest.note: Manifest v2 accepted by catalog.php under engineering-change with no new error or warning; since revision 1.1 the manifest carries only entry, medium and lifecycle, and the node with its edges (obsolescenceltb -> changeimpact, repairreplace, equivalence) lives in workflow-map.json (AGENTS.md section 2.7).

localisation.note: Opened in en, uk, de, nl, fr, es and pl: no undefined/NaN/[object Object] rendered, no console errors; the default study and its provenance sources are built in the reader's language.

mobile_desktop.note: Rendered at 1440 and 390 px with no root horizontal overflow, before and after a calculation.

permalink_round_trip.note: Each of the five examples opened from its permalink in a fresh page reproduces the state and every record output; a restored state passes through the vocabulary check and names replaced values in a warning.

presets.note: Five editable examples (available analogue with zero observed demand, discontinued PLC, critical sensor with no demand history, empirical ageing scenarios, one-million-unit fleet consumable) applied in all seven languages with complete records.

learn_mode.note: Eight topics and a seven-step tour, including the try / explanation / correction case on a two-year lead time (lead coverage 67.7 % against a 95 % target, no quantity) and the approval-binding topic.

report_all_languages.note: Report generated in seven languages, 4 pages each, footer URL on every page, no untranslated sentence, no duplicated line.

python_export.note: Exported script runs on the standard library; self-test reproduces 6 covered outputs of the record within 1e-9 relative for every example, including the input checks that decide availability.

benchmark_regeneration_parity.note: window.__dgcBenchmark() on the deployed page regenerates benchmarks/obsolescenceltb.json byte for byte.

console.note: No page errors or console errors in any QA run.
